resources.string: Distances, paths and areas by marking points with the crosshair. Needs Google Play Services for AR.
To measure with augmented reality, Mede Aí uses the camera to recognize the room. Nothing is recorded.
This phone does not support augmented reality (ARCore). Use the photo or tilt measurements.
Measuring with augmented reality needs Google Play Services for AR. Come back to this screen to try again.
Aim at the start and tap Add point
Mark the corners: at least 3 points
Move the phone slowly to recognize the room.
Too dark: turn on a light or move somewhere brighter.
Aim at something with texture (plain white walls are hard).
Augmented reality stopped working on this phone. Use the photo or tilt measurements.
Another app is using the camera.
Recognizing the room again… move the phone slowly.
Aim at the floor or a wall and move the phone slowly.
Far: beyond 5 m the measurement loses precision.
The outline’s sides cross: the area is not valid.
Typical error 1% to 3%. Not a replacement for a tape measure in critical measurements.
Use a card or an A4 sheet as a reference. Works on any phone.
Distance and height of objects, aiming with the camera.
Bubble level for surfaces and edges.
Version %1$s. Free, no ads, no internet access and no data collection. Open source under the GPL-3.0 license. Measurements are estimates: they do not replace a tape measure for critical work.
This device has no tilt sensor.
Tilt of the phone\'s edge from horizontal or vertical
Lay the phone on the surface or stand it on its edge.
To measure by tilt, Mede Aí shows the camera image while you aim. Nothing is recorded.
1. Aim the cross at the base of the object, where it touches the floor, and tap Mark base.
2. Without changing the phone\'s height, aim at the top of the object and tap Mark top.
Aim at the top of the object
Hold the phone the way you will while measuring and measure its height above the floor once. The more exact this height, the better the measurement.
Place a card (bank or ID card) or an A4 sheet on the surface you want to measure and take the photo straight on. Then mark the reference\'s corners and tap two points to measure.
Could not open the photo. Try another one.
Tap the 4 corners of %1$s (%2$d of 4). Drag to adjust.
The corners do not form a rectangle. Drag each one to a corner of the reference.
Tap two points to measure. Only points on the same surface as %1$s are valid.
Enter the width and height of a rectangular object in the photo.
